items.q: Do you tow at night and on weekends?
items.a: Yes. Spillane's dispatches tow trucks 24/7, including nights, weekends and holidays.

items.q: How much does a tow cost?
items.a: It depends on the vehicle, the distance and the situation, like a winch-out or an accident. Call us with your location and we'll walk you through it.
Burlington, South Burlington, Winooski, Essex, Essex Junction, Williston, Colchester, Shelburne and Jericho, dispatched from 7 Commerce Ave.

items.a: Yes. We run 16 flatbeds, which carry the whole vehicle off the ground.

items.a: Wherever you need it: home, your mechanic, the dealership, or our own service bays in South Burlington if you want us to fix it.
